'''The Epsilon Program''' is a fictional [[Religion|religious]] cult across a number of ''[[Grand Theft Auto]]'' games, led by [[Cris Formage (3D Universe)|Cris Formage]].

==Description==
The cult first emerged as a teaser site<ref>[http://web.archive.org/web/20041206004230/http://epsilonprogram.com The official Epsilon Program website in 2004 (Internet Archive)]</ref> for ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]'' and later referenced numerous times on [[Radio Stations in GTA San Andreas|radio stations]] and by [[pedestrians]] in the game itself. The cult is an obvious scam, intended to gain [[money]] by brainwashing its followers into paying large sums of money, parodying the real life [[wikipedia:Church of Scientology|Church of Scientology]]. In Formage's own words, it is "''a fellowship of like-minded adults who tithe money in exchange for salvation and merit badges''".

The Epsilon Program apparently existed as early as [[1984]] when [[Tina Jane]], a DJ for [[Vice City For Lovers|VCFL]] in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories]]'' references the program on her radio show, indicating that a friend was trying to get her to join. Their influence seems to have continued as late as [[2001]], as shown when a man calls into [[Chatterbox FM]] to say: "''That last guy was so full of crap; Everyone knows women are made from sand!''", only for Lazlow to quickly hang up on him, dismissing the caller as "another lunatic".

==Religious beliefs==
The main ideals of the Epsilon Program are established on their website. The religions main deity is Kifflom, and members follow his twelve tenets:

#The world is consistently [[1835|157 years old]] every year.
#Dinosaurs are a lie that people believe because they are weak.
#You are happy, you just don't know it.
#We all come from the same tree.
#Everyone is related to everyone else, except for people with red hair.
#Sperm does not exist - it is a lie spread by biology teachers - along with everything else you have ever been told.
#Men are supposed to lie with nine new partners a week. Women are supposed to lie with six, except for in July, when they must lie with five men a day.
#Aliens exist and are present on earth. If you have a birth mark, you may be descended from Kraff, the famous Emperor of the 4th Paradigm.
#Trees talk, but only some people hear them.
#People who believe in something live much longer than atheists, and they have eternal life thrown in for good measure.
#If you believe this and turn your hands and wallet over to EPSILONISM, you'll live a happy life. Otherwise you are doomed.
#KIFFLOM - HAPPINESS IS YOURS! KIFFLOM!

{{quote|Cris Formage tells us in his wonderful book, It Happened To Us All, that the TRACT will be written when we are all ready. However, Cris is also very clear on another point - although the TRACT has not yet been written, it can still be read by those that are willing to read it.}}

Their site contains a page about the Tract, which is expected to hold the truth about Epsilon. However, the site states that the tract has not yet been written. There is an address in Grand Canaria to send a cheque to, from which you would supposedly be sent a copy of the Tract. Grand Canaria is located in the [[wp:Cayman Islands|Cayman Islands]], which is well known as a tax haven and offshore location for many dubious companies. Unlike most places outside the USA that are mentioned in the GTA universe, Grand Canaria is a fictional place based on [[wp:Grand Cayman|Grand Cayman]]. Alternatively, it could be possible that [[Rockstar]] got Grand Canaria confused up with the [[Spain|Spanish]] island of [[wp:Gran Canaria|Gran Canaria]].

==Members==
The cult's founder and leader is Cris Formage. In ''GTA San Andreas'', he can be heard on [[West Coast Talk Radio (3D Universe)|the radio]] arguing with [[Lazlow Jones (3D Universe)|Lazlow Jones]] and fellow con-artist [[Darius Fontaine (3D Universe)|Darius Fontaine]].

The cult attracts many celebrities, including musicians [[Jezz Torrent (3D Universe)|Jezz Torrent]] and [[Maccer]], who both claim the cult helped them with their drug addictions. [[West Coast Talk Radio (3D Universe)|WCTR]] host [[Billy Dexter]] is also believed to be a member of the cult, as he occasionally says "Kifflom" during [[Entertaining America|his show]].

Other followers are listed on the cult website under "testimonials":

*[[Brian Van Ginsberg]]
*[[Dwayne Thorn]]
*[[Jane Pole]]
*[[Jeremy Smith]]
*[[Jonas Ackerman]]
*[[Marvin Trill]]
*[[Mary Fortune]]
*[[Morgan August]]

The cult is mentioned in small talk by pedestrians in [[State of San Andreas (3D Universe)|San Andreas]]; a certain kind of pedestrian commonly found around [[Verdant Bluffs]] (identifiable by his rucksack) and some [[Barbers]] (excluding [[Old Reece]]) claim to be followers. Additionally, the barber from [[Marina (3D Universe)|Marina]] in [[Los Santos (3D Universe)|Los Santos]] will sometimes say "Epsilon smiles on you, uncle brother" or "Let Epsilon tame your follicles".
However, [[Katie Zhan]], one of [[Carl Johnson]]'s [[Girlfriends in GTA San Andreas|girlfriends]], is not impressed with the cult and will occasionally refer to them as "nutjobs" during a date.

==Trivia==
*During a radio commercial, it is revealed that the [[Phone Numbers|phone number]] for the Epsilon Program is "1-866-FUN-CULT", or exactly '1-866-386-2858' when converted.
*Cris Formage is one of a few selected characters to appear in both the [[3D Universe]] and [[HD Universe]] of the ''GTA'' series, together with [[Lazlow Jones]] and [[Fernando Martinez]].
*The belief by Epsilonists that the world was created in the 1800s is a possible satirical allusion to {{WP|Young Earth creationism}}, a religiously motivated form of pseudoscience which allege that the Earth was formed between 6000 and 10,000 years ago, as opposed to established scientific studies which posit that the Earth and its life forms have evolved in a span reaching billions of years.
